recommendations.claim: Creatine monohydrate supports muscular work capacity and strength recovery in resistance-trained adults across an established meta-analytic base of >100 RCTs.
recommendations.source: Lanhers et al. 2017 (Eur J Sport Sci meta-analysis, n=1,258); Rawson & Volek 2003; IOM creatine safety review 2002. maturity_rung: established. certainty: high; strength: strong.
recommendations.reversibility: fully reversible; cessation clears within 4-6 weeks with no documented rebound

payload.name: Creatine monohydrate
payload.timing: post-exercise or with any meal; loading phase optional

recommendations.claim: Omega-3 fatty acids (EPA+DHA) attenuate exercise-induced muscle soreness and support inflammatory resolution relevant to musculoskeletal recovery.
recommendations.source: Philpott et al. 2018 (J Int Soc Sports Nutr systematic review, ~25 RCTs, n>1,000); Smith et al. 2011 (JISSN). maturity_rung: trial-stage for recovery outcomes; monograph-backed for cardiovascular surrogate outcomes. certainty: moderate; strength: weak (recovery-specific endpoint). adulteration_flag: heavy-metal/PCB contamination documented in non-tested products - prefer IFOS or NSF certified. dshea_status: conventional ingredient, no enforcement action as of 2026-06-18.
recommendations.reversibility: fully reversible; no documented discontinuation effect

payload.name: Omega-3 (EPA+DHA)
payload.timing: with meals containing fat to reduce GI side-effects

recommendations.claim: Magnesium glycinate supports sleep architecture quality and neuromuscular relaxation, both relevant to the recovery-priority goal, at doses within the IOM supplemental Tolerable Upper Intake Level.
recommendations.source: Abbasi et al. 2012 (J Res Med Sci, RCT n=46, sleep quality); Nielsen et al. 2010 (Magnes Res, muscle function). maturity_rung: trial-stage. certainty: low; strength: conditional. ul_status: IOM supplemental UL = 350 mg/day; dose below UL. worst_case_h_class: H7 (osmotic diarrhea, self-limiting, reversible). interaction_screen: no Rx regimen reported; no flag.
recommendations.reversibility: fully reversible; no documented discontinuation effect

recommendations.claim: Hydrolyzed collagen peptides combined with vitamin C, timed around exercise, show connective-tissue and tendon-support signals relevant to the musculoskeletal recovery priority.
recommendations.source: Shaw et al. 2017 (Am J Clin Nutr, RCT n=8, tendon collagen synthesis); Praet et al. 2019 (Nutrients, RCT n=41, Achilles rehab). maturity_rung: trial-stage (small-RCT base, n<700 aggregate). certainty: low; strength: conditional. ul_status: no UL established. worst_case_h_class: H8. renal_flag: renal status NOT populated - protein load at this dose (15 g) is modest and not expected to be clinically relevant at normal GFR; flag for medical-liaison review given unknown status.
recommendations.reversibility: fully reversible; no documented discontinuation effect
